devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:The libffi is currently declared as toolexeclib_LTLIBRARIES. In many
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:cases, toolexeclib libraries will be installed in /usr/lib, so it
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:However, with multilib toolchains, they get installed in a
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:subdirectory of /usr/lib/. For example, with a Sourcery CodeBench
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:PowerPC toolchain, if the e500mc multilib variant is used, the libffi
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:library gets installed in /usr/lib/te500mc/. This is due to the
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:    *) toolexeclibdir=$toolexeclibdir/$multi_os_directory ;;
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:Once the library is installed in /usr/lib/te500mc/, nothing works
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:installation location declared in libffi.pc.
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:So, instead of using this bizarre toolexeclib_LTLIBRARIES, simply use
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:the more standard lib_LTLIBRARIES, which ensures that the libffi
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:library is always installed in /usr/lib.
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:-toolexeclib_LTLIBRARIES = libffi.la
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch:+lib_LTLIBRARIES = libffi.la
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch: noinst_LTLIBRARIES = libffi_convenience.la
devel/libffi/patches/libffi-Fix-installation-location-of-libffi.patch: libffi_la_SOURCES = src/prep_cif.c src/types.c \

addons/addon-depends/tslib/patches/tslib-10-ts_uinput_touch-daemon.patch:Subject: [PATCH 01/11] ts_uinput_touch: daemon translates tslib events to
addons/addon-depends/tslib/patches/tslib-10-ts_uinput_touch-daemon.patch:On one side it gets events from touchscreen using tslib library. On the other end it creates one new virtual device using uinput kernel module that allows to handle the input subsystem from user land. Inside application data from tslib is translated to uinput events. For now only ABS_X, ABS_Y, ABS_PRESSURE and BTN_TOUCH. It behaves in a similar way than touchpad. Short tap sends button press event and long slide sends only xy coordinates. Currently using it in OpenELEC distribution and Kodi application.
